info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Logistics Shipments Exceptions-v5-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Exceptions API provides access to a comprehensive list of exceptions occurring in logistics shipments. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about discrepancies that may arise during the shipping process, including reasons for delays or issues. Typical consumers include logistics managers, warehouse operations teams, and customer service representatives who need visibility into shipment status. The API enables organizations to proactively address exceptions, enhance operational efficiency, and improve customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of exceptions related to shipments. Useful for tracking and managing issues that may have occurred during the shipment process.
